title: Receiving at the showroom
intro: Garments returning from the workshop are listed on the Receiving Brova / Final page.

steps.title: Record receipt at the showroom
steps.body: Open Receiving Brova / Final, locate the order, and select Receive (1). A final becomes ready for pickup and proceeds to handover, as described in chapter [[ref:09-handover.order-detail]]. A brova instead becomes awaiting trial, since the customer has yet to try it.
